text: This solution, Scaling-up of Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) Risk Reduction in Northern Pakistan (GLOF-II) addresses natural catastrophe in Pakistan between Government of Pakistan, Government of Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan Meteorological Department, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), and Green Climate Fund (GCF). The program was implemented in 2017 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
